proposition: The Naqshbandi Kāshifīs, father and son, recognised Ibn Turka as the preeminent lettrist, and Yazdī appears in the Rashaḥāt as a promoter of Ibn ʿArabī, yet Jāmī minimised the Isfahan Circle (MK on pdf p.440; the sections on the Kāshifīs, §§4.4.2 and 4.4.4, were not read by R7).
